name: Photon
notes: Bevel & Emboss, Satin and Pattern Overlay styles; pattern fill layers, Fill with Pattern and Define Pattern; Warp; Edit › Fade; Paste Into; Distribute; Replace Color; Patch, Background Eraser, Pattern Stamp and Color Sampler tools; Save a Copy. Closing Photon asks to save each unsaved document (the window close button needs Crystal Suite 0.2.1).
